comment_drafts.author: sparkie_90
comment_drafts.comment: Put on end tidal or rad57 will help too
comment_drafts.reply: Good call on the Rad 57. A CO oximeter reads carbon monoxide directly, which a regular pulse ox can't. End tidal is great for breathing, but it measures CO2, so it won't flag CO poisoning on its own.

comment_drafts.author: fattie8652
comment_drafts.comment: wouldn't the axial hydrogens turn into equatorial
comment_drafts.reply: You're right, good catch. In a real ring flip every axial spot becomes equatorial, hydrogens included, and our animation left those two axial. We've fixed it. Thanks for watching that closely!

comment_drafts.author: robbiebehnke2
comment_drafts.comment: repeat after me high and tight
comment_drafts.reply: High and tight is the right move when you can't see the wound or the scene isn't safe. Once you can see it, 2 to 3 inches above the wound and off the joint works best.

comment_drafts.author: cabezon_85
comment_drafts.comment: If not certified to place a tourniquet on someone you will cause more harm than good
comment_drafts.reply: Training really helps, and a free Stop the Bleed class takes about an hour. But on a life threatening bleed a tourniquet is the right call even for bystanders, and limb damage is rare when it comes off within about two hours.

comment_drafts.author: lil.miwa
comment_drafts.comment: Most people aren't doing a high and tight that a very military and like police thing this is like your at work in a civilian jobs
comment_drafts.reply: Fair point. High and tight comes from tactical care, where you can't stop to find the wound. If you can see the bleed, 2 to 3 inches above it works best.

comment_drafts.author: user7239963906276
comment_drafts.reply: Thanks! Glad the resonance part clicked.

comment_drafts.author: cg02q_
comment_drafts.comment: I love SN2 but not AI
comment_drafts.reply: Fair! The art gets AI help, but the chemistry is checked before anything posts. Glad you love SN2 too.

comment_drafts.author: brandoo245
comment_drafts.comment: If you are doing ring flips the direction does not change so up stays up and down stays down the only thing you change is axial and equatorial don't just follow ai like this one blindly it's giving you the wrong message tbu would go from ax up to eq up
comment_drafts.reply: You're right, thanks for calling it out. A ring flip keeps every group on the same face, so axial up becomes equatorial up, and our animation got the hydrogens wrong. The point that big groups prefer equatorial still holds, but the drawing should have shown that.
